title: All right
text: All right. This painting is okay. It is a pretty good deal for a real painting, but it is not going to be close to what it looked like from the original painter. There wasn't anything inherently wrong with it, but I just felt underwhelmed. The colors weren't exactly the same and it was not as detailed. We will not be displaying it. So not a bad price for real work and I would imagine all will be different based on who you get to paint it, but for us just okay.
